name: freellmapi-desktop
description: FreeLLMAPI menu-bar app — local OpenAI-compatible LLM router

scripts.build:all: npm run bundle:server && npm run build:main && npm run build:preload
scripts.dist: npm run build:all && npm run stage:client && electron-builder --mac --arm64 --publish never
scripts.dist:win: npm run build:all && npm run stage:client && electron-builder --win --x64 --publish never
scripts.dist:linux: npm run build:all && npm run stage:client && electron-builder --linux --x64 --publish never
